rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: There are two piles of cards:
rules.home.text: for things to do at home.
rules.draw: Pick a pile, draw a card, and let chance do its thing.
rules.foil: Some cards are rare. Spicier and drawn less often, they shimmer when revealed.
rules.reveal: Once the card is revealed, you have two options:
rules.return: Return the card to the pile so it can come back later.
rules.ban: Ban the card to remove it permanently. You can still restore it from the Collection.
rules.swipe: Besides the buttons, you can swipe the revealed card left to ban it or right to return it to the pile. Sound familiar…
demo.banner: Demo mode. Data is reset at every sign-in.
admin.title: Administration
admin.users.create.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores only.
admin.users.initialPassword.title: Initial password for {{username}}
admin.users.initialPassword.warn: This password is shown only once. Copy and share it securely. The user will be forced to change it on first sign-in.
admin.users.reset.body: A new one-time password will be generated. The user will have to change it on next sign-in.
admin.users.delete.body: Their history and bans will also be deleted.
admin.users.search.empty.title: No matches
admin.cards.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
admin.cards.translation.hint: Optional. Fill both fields to ship this locale.
admin.cards.emojiHint: Fluent slug (for instance "pizza"). Leave blank to use the pile icon.
admin.cards.delete.body: This card will also be removed from every user's banned list.
admin.cards.empty.title: The deck is empty
admin.cards.empty.hint: Add a card manually or import a deck from the Deck maintenance block above.
admin.cards.search.empty.title: No matches
admin.cards.tools.title: Deck maintenance
admin.cards.tools.hint: Keep the database aligned with the JSON files versioned on the server. Export the current deck to back it up before any operation.
admin.cards.deleteAll.body: This wipes every card and its translations from the database. Useful before importing your own deck. This action cannot be undone.
admin.deckSync.title: Sync the deck
admin.deckSync.intro: Load the deck shipped with the server and apply it to the database.
admin.deckSync.mode.mirror.hint: The database exactly mirrors the file. Cards present in the database but missing from the file are deleted (along with their bans).
admin.deckSync.mode.upsert.hint: Adds new cards and updates existing ones. Cards missing from the file are kept as-is.
admin.deckSync.backupHint: It is recommended to export a backup before applying a full mirror sync.
admin.deckSync.summary.title: Summary
admin.deckImport.title: Import a backup
admin.deckImport.intro: Load a JSON file in the deck format to replace or top up the database.
